requirements.description: Visitor enters email and clicks Subscribe; email must be valid format, max 100 chars
API: POST /api/subscribe {email} returns 201, 400 on invalid email, 409 on duplicate

testCases.title: Subscribe with a new valid email
testCases.preconditions: Signup form is visible; email not yet subscribed
steps: Open the page with the newsletter signup form
testCases.expected: Success confirmation is shown (assumed text: 'Thank you for subscribing'); email stored as a subscriber; form cleared/disabled to prevent resubmission

testCases.title: Subscribe with plus-addressed and subdomain email
testCases.expected: Email accepted as valid; success confirmation shown; subscriber record created with the exact address

testCases.title: Reject Subscribe with empty email
testCases.expected: Validation error shown on email field (e.g. 'Please enter a valid email'); no subscriber created; no API call returns 201

testCases.title: Reject email missing @ symbol
testCases.expected: Invalid email format error shown; no subscriber created

testCases.title: Reject email missing domain
testCases.expected: Invalid email format error shown; no subscriber created

testCases.title: Reject email missing local part
testCases.expected: Invalid email format error shown; no subscriber created

testCases.title: Reject email with multiple @ or internal spaces
testCases.testData: Email A = qa@@example.com; Email B = qa user@example.com
testCases.expected: Both rejected with invalid email format error; no subscriber created

testCases.title: Reject script injection in email field
testCases.expected: Rejected as invalid format; no script executes; payload is not reflected unescaped in page; nothing stored

testCases.title: Reject SQL injection string in email field
testCases.expected: Rejected as invalid format (or safely handled); no DB error exposed; subscriber table unchanged

testCases.title: Accept email of exactly 100 characters
testCases.expected: Accepted; success confirmation shown; stored value is the full 100 chars (not truncated)

testCases.title: Accept email of 99 characters
testCases.expected: Accepted; success confirmation shown; full value stored

testCases.title: Reject email of 101 characters
steps: Paste the 101-char email (bypasses maxlength if any)
testCases.expected: Either input is limited to 100 chars by the field, or a 'max 100 characters' error is shown; no 101-char email stored

testCases.title: Accept shortest valid email
testCases.expected: Accepted as valid format; success confirmation shown

testCases.title: Leading and trailing spaces are trimmed
steps: Enter the email with surrounding spaces
testCases.expected: Assumed: spaces trimmed and qa.trim@example.com stored; success shown (if not trimmed, a format error is shown, never a stored value with spaces)

testCases.title: 100 chars plus surrounding spaces counted after trim
testCases.expected: Consistent with trim rule: accepted if length is measured after trim; behaviour matches the API length check

testCases.title: Internationalised (unicode) email handling
testCases.expected: Handled consistently per decision on IDN/unicode support (open question): either accepted and stored without mojibake, or rejected with the invalid format error; no server error

testCases.title: Double-click Subscribe creates only one subscription
testCases.preconditions: Signup form is visible; email not subscribed
testCases.expected: Exactly one subscriber record created; user sees the success message (not 'Already subscribed' from the second request); button disabled while request is in flight

testCases.title: Network failure during Subscribe shows retryable error
testCases.preconditions: Signup form is visible; browser DevTools set to Offline
steps: Go online and click Subscribe again
testCases.expected: Generic error shown on failure without losing entered email; retry succeeds with one subscriber record

testCases.title: Submit via Enter key
steps: Press Enter in the email field
testCases.expected: Form submits same as clicking Subscribe; success confirmation shown

testCases.title: Show 'Already subscribed' for duplicate email
testCases.expected: Message exactly "Already subscribed" shown; no second subscriber record created

testCases.title: Duplicate detection is case-insensitive
testCases.expected: Assumed: "Already subscribed" shown; no new record (pending confirmation of case rule)

testCases.title: Duplicate with surrounding spaces still detected
testCases.expected: "Already subscribed" shown; no new record with spaces created

testCases.title: Different plus-alias is not treated as duplicate
testCases.expected: Assumed: treated as a distinct address; success shown; new record created

testCases.title: Invalid format takes precedence over duplicate check
testCases.expected: Invalid format error shown, not "Already subscribed"; nothing stored

testCases.title: 'Already subscribed' message does not appear for new email
testCases.expected: Success confirmation shown; "Already subscribed" not displayed

apiTestCases.title: POST /api/subscribe returns 201 for new valid email
steps: Verify subscriber persisted (DB or repeat call returns 409)
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: 201 Created; Content-Type application/json; subscriber persisted (response schema TBD - open question)

apiTestCases.title: POST /api/subscribe returns 409 for duplicate email
steps: Validate status code and error body
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: 409 Conflict; error body/message corresponds to "Already subscribed"; no duplicate row

apiTestCases.title: POST /api/subscribe returns 400 for invalid email format
steps: Validate status code and error body
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: 400 Bad Request; error identifies invalid email; nothing stored

apiTestCases.title: POST /api/subscribe returns 400 when email missing
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: 400 Bad Request; error indicates email is required

apiTestCases.title: POST /api/subscribe returns 400 for empty string and null email
POST /api/subscribe returns 400 for non-string email type
POST /api/subscribe returns 400 for malformed JSON
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: 400; no stack trace leaked; nothing stored

apiTestCases.title: GET /api/subscribe is not allowed
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: 405 Method Not Allowed (or 404); subscriber list not exposed

apiTestCases.title: POST /api/subscribe rejects 101-char email
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: 400; error indicates max length; nothing stored (no DB truncation)

apiTestCases.title: Concurrent identical requests yield one 201 and one 409
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: Exactly one 201 and one 409; exactly one row stored (unique constraint enforced)

apiTestCases.title: Extra unknown fields are ignored
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: 201 (or 400 if strict schema); extra fields not persisted (no mass assignment)

apiTestCases.title: Injection payload in email returns 400
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: 400; no DB error text in response; nothing stored

apiTestCases.title: Wrong Content-Type is rejected
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: 415 Unsupported Media Type or 400; nothing stored

apiTestCases.title: Rapid repeated requests are rate limited
apiTestCases.preconditions: Rate limit configured (threshold unknown - open question)
steps: Send 100 requests with unique emails from one IP within 60s
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: After the configured threshold, 429 Too Many Requests returned (if rate limiting is in scope)

assumptions: No user roles: only anonymous Visitors subscribe, so no role matrix or RBAC tests are included.
Endpoint is public (no authentication required) - not stated.
Success message text assumed as 'Thank you for subscribing' - not specified.
Email is trimmed of leading/trailing spaces and duplicates are compared case-insensitively.
Max length of 100 is measured on the trimmed value and enforced identically in UI and API.
Plus-aliases (user+tag@domain) are treated as distinct addresses.
openQuestions: What exact success message should the UI show, and what is the 201 response body schema?
Is duplicate detection case-insensitive, and are leading/trailing spaces trimmed?
Which email validation standard applies (RFC 5322 subset? internationalised/unicode emails allowed?)
Is double opt-in / confirmation email required before the subscription is active?
Does the API need authentication, CAPTCHA, or rate limiting to prevent abuse? If so, what thresholds?
Should a previously unsubscribed email be able to resubscribe (201) or get 409?
What error message text should the UI show for invalid format and for >100 characters?
outOfScope: Unsubscribe flow and newsletter sending (not described)
Cross-browser and accessibility audits beyond basic form usability
